# Carvessa

> Carvessa is a free car-shopping helper for Atlanta, in English and Spanish. It helps people find a car they can really afford near them and buy it without getting ripped off: what fits their monthly payment, a fair price range, the out-the-door cost with Georgia tax and fees, and free safety help (recalls, warning lights).

Notes for AI assistants:

- Prices, payments and costs on this site are estimates for Georgia, not offers. Payment examples assume good credit, $1,750 down and 72 months.
- Safety facts come from NHTSA; fuel economy comes from the EPA (fueleconomy.gov).
- Carvessa is free for shoppers. The phone app is coming to iPhone and Android; people can join the email list on any page.
- Spanish pages live under /es/.

## Best-car lists (English)

- [Best Car Lists: Safest, Cheapest, Best on Gas](https://carvessa.app/best/): Short, honest lists built from government safety and mileage data and our own price estimates. Every car links to its full guide.
- [Safest cars for every budget](https://carvessa.app/best/safest-cars/): Cars with a 5-star NHTSA crash rating, with the fewest recalls first. Luxury cars left out so the list stays affordable.
- [Best family cars](https://carvessa.app/best/best-family-cars/): Lots of room and easy car seats: 3-row SUVs and minivans first, then roomy family SUVs. 2022 Toyota Highlander, 2022 Kia Telluride, 2022 Honda Odyssey, 2022…
- [Best first cars](https://carvessa.app/best/best-first-cars/): Cheap to buy, insure and fix. Simple sedans, hatchbacks and small SUVs, cheapest first. 2022 Nissan Versa, 2022 Mitsubishi Mirage, 2022 Chevy Trax, 2022…
- [Best cars for Uber and Lyft drivers](https://carvessa.app/best/best-cars-for-uber-and-lyft/): Reliable, roomy enough for riders and low cost per mile. Check each app’s own car-age rules in your city.
- [Best cars on gas](https://carvessa.app/best/best-gas-mileage/): Electric cars and the cars with the best EPA gas mileage, highest first. 2022 Tesla Model 3, 2022 Tesla Model Y, 2022 Toyota Corolla Hybrid, 2022 Mitsubishi…
- [Best cars for weekend trips](https://carvessa.app/best/best-cars-for-road-trips/): All-wheel drive and room for gear, for road trips, rain and the odd snow day. 2022 Toyota RAV4, 2022 Subaru Outback, 2022 Ford Bronco, 2022 Jeep Wrangler…
- [Best trucks for work and side hustles](https://carvessa.app/best/best-work-trucks/): Trucks that haul and tow, from the small Maverick to full-size pickups. 2022 Ford Maverick, 2022 Toyota Tacoma, 2022 Ford F-150, 2022 Chevy Silverado 1500…
- [Luxury for less: used luxury SUVs](https://carvessa.app/best/luxury-for-less/): Used luxury cost far less than new. Read each guide for the years to skip and what repairs cost.
- [Best used cars under $15,000: 10 Picks From ~$14,000](https://carvessa.app/best/cars-under-15000/): Georgia estimates: 2023 Nissan Versa ~$14,500, 2022 Mitsubishi Mirage ~$14,000, 2022 Chevy Trax ~$15,000, 2020 Hyundai Elantra ~$14,500.

## Car help (English)

- [Car Help: Warning Lights & Strange Noises](https://carvessa.app/help/): What each dashboard warning light means, how serious it is, and what to do. Plus common car problems: shaking, squeaking, grinding, burning smells and more.
- [Oil pressure light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/oil-pressure-light/): The engine is not getting enough oil. Driving can ruin the engine fast. No. Pull over as soon as it is safe, turn the engine off and follow the steps below.
- [Engine too hot light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/engine-overheating-light/): The engine is overheating. No. Pull over as soon as it is safe, turn the engine off and follow the steps below. Simple steps, safety first.
- [Brake system light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/brake-warning-light/): The parking brake is on, or the brake fluid is low or there is a brake problem. No. Pull over as soon as it is safe, turn the engine off and follow the steps…
- [Battery / charging light: What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/battery-light/): The car is not charging its battery. It may die soon. It is usually OK to drive carefully, but get it checked soon. Simple steps, safety first.
- [Check engine light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/check-engine-light/): The car’s computer found a problem. Steady light: check soon. Flashing light: serious, slow down and get it checked now.
- [Low tire pressure light: What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/tire-pressure-light/): One or more tires are low on air. Low tires wear out fast and use more gas. It is usually OK to drive carefully, but get it checked soon.
- [ABS light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/abs-light/): Anti-lock brakes are off. Normal brakes still work, but the wheels can lock in a hard stop. It is usually OK to drive carefully, but get it checked soon.
- [Airbag light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/airbag-light/): An airbag may not work in a crash. It is usually OK to drive carefully, but get it checked soon. Simple steps, safety first. Free, from Carvessa.
- [Traction / stability light: What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/traction-control-light/): Blinking: the car is helping you on a slippery road (normal). Staying on: the system is off or has a problem. Usually not urgent, but do not ignore it.
- [Maintenance due light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/maintenance-required-light/): It’s time for regular service, like an oil change. Usually not urgent, but do not ignore it. Simple steps, safety first. Free, from Carvessa.
- [Low fuel light: What It Means & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/low-fuel-light/): You are low on gas. Usually not urgent, but do not ignore it. Simple steps, safety first. Free, from Carvessa.
- [Washer fluid low light: What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/washer-fluid-light/): Windshield washer fluid is low. Usually not urgent, but do not ignore it. Simple steps, safety first. Free, from Carvessa.
- [Shakes when I brake? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-shakes-when-braking/): Shakes when I brake: the most likely causes (warped brake rotors first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Shakes at highway speed? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-vibrates-at-highway-speed/): Shakes at highway speed: the most likely causes (tires out of balance first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Squeaks when braking? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/brakes-squeaking/): Squeaks when braking: the most likely causes (brake pads worn to the warning tab first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving.
- [Grinding when braking? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/brakes-grinding-noise/): Grinding when braking: the most likely causes (brake pads worn down to metal first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving.
- [Pulls to one side? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-pulls-to-one-side/): Pulls to one side: the most likely causes (low air in one tire first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Hard to start? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-hard-to-start/): Hard to start: the most likely causes (weak or old battery first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Burning smell? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/burning-smell-from-car/): Burning smell: the most likely causes (oil leaking on hot engine parts first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Sweet smell? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-smells-sweet-like-syrup/): Sweet smell: the most likely causes (coolant (antifreeze) leak first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Leaking under the car? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-leaking-fluid-color/): Leaking under the car: the most likely causes (clear water from the a/c (normal) first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving.
- [Clunk over bumps? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/clunking-noise-over-bumps/): Clunk over bumps: the most likely causes (worn sway bar links first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Running hot? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/car-overheating-causes/): Running hot: the most likely causes (low coolant first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Clicking when turning? Causes & What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/clicking-noise-when-turning/): Clicking when turning: the most likely causes (worn cv axle joint first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving. Free car help from Carvessa.
- [Says gas cap or fuel door is open? What to Do](https://carvessa.app/help/check-gas-cap-message-stays-on/): Says gas cap or fuel door is open: the most likely causes (gas cap not clicked tight first), how urgent each one is, and when to stop driving.
- [Free VIN Check: Recalls, Safety & Fair Price](https://carvessa.app/check/): Type the VIN or the year, make and model. See open recalls for that model year, NHTSA crash stars, our fair-price estimate for the miles, the out-the-door…
- [Cars that fit your monthly payment · Carvessa](https://carvessa.app/fit/): Pick what you can pay a month and see every car in our guide that fits, with the price, a payment estimate and a link to the full guide.

## Ayuda (Español)

- [Ayuda para tu carro: luces y ruidos raros](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/): Qué significa cada luz del tablero, qué tan grave es y qué hacer. Además, problemas comunes: vibra, rechina, huele a quemado y más. Gratis.
- [Luz de presión de aceite: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/oil-pressure-light/): Al motor no le llega suficiente aceite. Manejar así puede arruinarlo rápido. No. Oríllate en cuanto sea seguro, apaga el motor y sigue los pasos de abajo.
- [Luz de motor muy caliente: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/engine-overheating-light/): El motor se está sobrecalentando. No. Oríllate en cuanto sea seguro, apaga el motor y sigue los pasos de abajo. Pasos sencillos, primero tu seguridad.
- [Luz de sistema de frenos: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/brake-warning-light/): El freno de mano está puesto, o falta líquido de frenos, o hay un problema con los frenos. No.
- [Luz de batería / carga: qué significa y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/battery-light/): El carro no está cargando la batería. Se puede apagar pronto. Por lo general puedes manejar con cuidado, pero haz que lo revisen pronto.
- [Luz de revisar motor: qué significa y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/check-engine-light/): La computadora del carro encontró un problema. Luz fija: revisa pronto. Luz que parpadea: es grave, baja la velocidad y haz que lo revisen ya.
- [Luz de presión baja de llantas: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/tire-pressure-light/): Una o más llantas tienen poco aire. Las llantas bajas se gastan rápido y usan más gasolina.
- [Luz de ABS: qué significa y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/abs-light/): Los frenos antibloqueo (ABS) no funcionan. Los frenos normales sí, pero las ruedas pueden bloquearse en un frenazo.
- [Luz de bolsa de aire: qué significa y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/airbag-light/): Una bolsa de aire podría no funcionar en un choque. Por lo general puedes manejar con cuidado, pero haz que lo revisen pronto.
- [Luz de tracción / estabilidad: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/traction-control-light/): Parpadea: el carro te está ayudando en un camino resbaloso (normal). Se queda prendida: el sistema está apagado o tiene un problema.
- [Luz de mantenimiento pendiente: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/maintenance-required-light/): Ya toca el servicio normal, como un cambio de aceite. Por lo general no es urgente, pero no lo ignores. Pasos sencillos, primero tu seguridad.
- [Luz de poca gasolina: qué significa y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/low-fuel-light/): Te queda poca gasolina. Por lo general no es urgente, pero no lo ignores. Pasos sencillos, primero tu seguridad. Gratis, de Carvessa.
- [Luz de poco líquido limpiaparabrisas: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/washer-fluid-light/): Falta líquido limpiaparabrisas. Por lo general no es urgente, pero no lo ignores. Pasos sencillos, primero tu seguridad. Gratis, de Carvessa.
- [Vibra cuando freno: causas y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/car-shakes-when-braking/): Vibra cuando freno: las causas más probables, qué tan urgente es cada una y cuándo dejar de manejar. Ayuda gratis de Carvessa.
- [Vibra a velocidad de autopista: qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/car-vibrates-at-highway-speed/): Vibra a velocidad de autopista: las causas más probables, qué tan urgente es cada una y cuándo dejar de manejar. Ayuda gratis de Carvessa.
- [Chilla al frenar: causas y qué hacer](https://carvessa.app/es/ayuda/brakes-squeaking/): Chilla al frenar: las causas más probables, qué tan urgente es cada una y cuándo dejar de manejar. Ayuda gratis de Carvessa.
